nodes.text: About Clyde Hill

Clyde Hill, an upscale residential city adjacent to Bellevue in King County, Washington, is home to roughly 3,050 residents as of 2025. The city is characterized by quiet neighborhoods, spacious lots, and panoramic views of Lake Washington, the Seattle skyline, and the Olympic Mountains.
